tolerances.rationale: Canonical matrix components are exact up to floating-point epsilon; a larger epsilon would accept a real transform change as noise.
The renderer transform is compared to the canonical projection per point and axis within one quarter of a CSS pixel, the accepted rendering tolerance.
Raster edge agreement is compared within one effective backing pixel; a wider band would hide a real raster drift.
A native interaction origin must clear a declared safety inset and a target region must be large enough to host a safe drag.
